snippet.title: Long Drive North: Co-Op RV Simulator - Early Access Reveal Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Hit the road into the wild with Long Drive North. Drive and maintain your trusty old RV, scavenge for parts, hunt and cook your way through a post-disaster American wilderness. Play alone or with up to four friends in online co-op as you explore open-world sandbox zones with no zombies or monsters—just survival, freedom and the open highway.

Early Access drops November 6 on PC. Wishlist it now on Steam and be one of the first to embark on the journey.
